verdict.rationale: Custom system theming with a GUI color and background picker is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers themes, accent colors, appearance settings, or wallpaper pickers. Items like the voice customization in macos-docs-32 concern a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a designer, I can create a custom system theme using a GUI color and background picker
